quote_volume_std.name: Quote Volume Standard Deviation
quote_volume_std.comment: Rolling standard deviation of Close * Volume proxy

positive_amplitude_rank.name: Positive Amplitude Rank
positive_amplitude_rank.comment: Rolling percentile rank of positive-price-change amplitude mean

apz_width.name: Adaptive Price Zone Width
apz_width.comment: Double EMA high-low volatility divided by double EMA close

pac_width_bias.name: Price Acceleration Channel Width Bias
pac_width_bias.comment: PAC width divided by rolling mean PAC width minus 1

env_position.name: Envelope Channel Position
env_position.comment: Close position inside +/-5 percent moving-average envelope

realized_volatility.name: Realized Volatility
realized_volatility.comment: Rolling standard deviation of one-bar returns

rwi.name: Random Walk Index Composite
rwi.comment: Close normalized within upward/downward Random Walk Index range

mssi.name: Market Sentiment Stability Index
mssi.comment: Max of average drawdown from rolling high and reverse drawdown from rolling low

vix_bw.name: VIX-like Bandwidth
vix_bw.comment: Signed adaptive bandwidth of n-period close return

adaptive_bollinger_width.name: Adaptive Bollinger Width
adaptive_bollinger_width.comment: Adaptive z-score Bollinger bandwidth normalized by close moving average

vwap_bbw_efficiency.name: VWAP BBW Efficiency
vwap_bbw_efficiency.comment: Rolling VWAP change times Bollinger-width change normalized by quote-volume proxy

chaikin_volatility.name: Chaikin Volatility
chaikin_volatility.comment: Rate of change of EMA high-low range

keltner_width.name: Keltner Width
keltner_width.comment: Keltner channel width normalized by EMA middle band

fibonacci_band_width.name: Fibonacci Band Width
fibonacci_band_width.comment: Fibonacci ATR channel width normalized by rolling close mean

fibonacci_band_position.name: Fibonacci Band Position
fibonacci_band_position.comment: Close position inside first Fibonacci ATR channel
